title: Hamraaz
desc: Kumar, a popular actor from Bombay, takes a trip to Darjeeling with his partner Shabhnam; while there, he meets and falls in love with Meena, the only daughter of a wealthy military contractor.

title: Bade Dilwala
desc: After losing his daughter, Juhi, in a train accident, Sinha meets her husband, Vijay, and makes him his heir. Then a doctor shows up with an amnesiac Juhi and a dark secret about Vijay.

title: Kirayadar
desc: Laxmi Abhyankar and her employed daughter Jaya live on rent in a flat on Pali Hill, Mumbai they rented years ago from Lucknow-based Kundanlal Choudhury. His son Anil comes to Mumbai and gets a job.

title: Meet Mere Man Ke
desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man of high principles falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her. However, the difference in their social statuses threatens to maim his plans.
